question: In which state, Kudankulam Nuclear Power Plant is established?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tamil Nadu**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kudankulam Nuclear Power Plant** is located in the state of **Tamil Nadu**.
 
• It is one of the largest nuclear power stations in India.
 
• The power plant was built with the collaboration of the **Russian company Atomstroyexport**.
 
• The plant is situated in **Kudankulam**, in the Tirunelveli district of Tamil Nadu.
 
• The first unit of the plant was **commissioned in 2013**, and the **second unit in 2016**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Nuclear Power Corporation of India Limited (NPCIL)** is responsible for the operation of the **Kudankulam Nuclear Power Plant**.
 
• The plant uses **Pressurized Water Reactors (PWRs)** of the **VVER-1000 model**.
 
• It is part of India's ambitious plan to increase its nuclear power generation capacity.
 
• The project faced several delays due to various reasons, including local protests and regulatory approvals.
 
• Once fully operational, the plant is expected to significantly boost the power supply in Tamil Nadu and the southern region of India.
